terra.problem: “Solomon’s great feast” was not held at the Brook of Egypt. The brook marks one end of the region the assembly came from.
“Babylon takes Egypt’s land” describes territory extending from the brook to the Euphrates; it does not say that a specific event happened at the brook.
“Gathered in that day” describes a region extending to the Wadi of Egypt, but does not say the gathering happens at the wadi itself.
“Watercourse,” “assembly,” “wadi,” and “thresh” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Use simpler wording or briefly explain the terms.
